method: OpenAI image_gen built-in tool, hand-drawn illustration generation and composition edits
requested_style: 简洁手绘：清楚的形体、少量笔触、柔和配色；自然不等于写实；保持原UI
initial_prompt: Use-case: stylized-concept, a finished SIMPLE HAND-DRAWN ILLUSTRATION for the background of a coastal driving game menu. The user wants an unforced, natural illustration with clear shapes, sparse brushwork and soft colors. This is NOT realism or photography. Horizontal 16:9, full bleed artwork with no text or UI. Art direction: confident, economical hand-painted gouache shapes on warm ivory paper, like a thoughtful illustrated travel journal cover. A few broad irregular brushstrokes and gently imperfect drawn contours. Clearly drawn, flat simplified shapes and selective detail. Soft muted sea blue, sage green, chalky warm grey road, cream sky, a little terracotta-orange. No simulated pixel texture or noisy painterly filler. No intricate micro-details, no luminous cinematic rendering, no photorealistic shading, no gradients pretending to be 3D. A quiet ordinary coast: one modest curving road on a low headland, calm sea, one low distant land silhouette, three or four loose shrub silhouettes. One simple orange older car seen from behind on the road on the lower-right, small but legible, a designed silhouette and two clear wheels, lightly drawn windows. Two or three loose long pale cloud shapes only, not piled fluffy clouds. Human illustrator's selectivity and generous breathing room. Composition has a specific UI constraint: keep the ENTIRE LEFT 40 percent almost empty warm ivory #f3efe3, a calm unmarked paper area for existing menu controls, extending from top to bottom. The illustrated scenery occupies the RIGHT 60 percent. Let the empty paper meet the scenery with a simple softly irregular vertical boundary, NOT a giant cloud, not a decorative torn paper frame. Keep the middle-right car and coast legible and leave the far-right bottom corner fairly quiet for an existing small button. Horizon gently varies around upper-middle. Light consistent daylight and soft broad shadow shapes. No lighthouse, village, enormous mountains, workshop, flowers, glossy reflections, sunset sunbeams, complex forests, fake writing, floating objects, borders, letters or labels. Avoid the overworked polished stock-AI fantasy landscape feeling. The result should read immediately as a restrained handmade illustration with a small number of well chosen forms. Keep real perspective coherent but let shapes be openly drawn rather than realistic.

final_edit_prompts.menu: Edit this hand-painted coastal road illustration, preserving its quiet gouache style, muted colors, simplified coast, left 40 percent unmarked ivory paper and full 16:9 canvas. The entire original UI will be placed over this art by the game, so add NO UI and NO text. Make one important composition adjustment: MOVE the small orange car LOWER DOWN the road, to the lower-right at about x=81% and y=84% of the image; the whole car should occupy roughly y=77% through 93% and remain clearly inside the canvas. This matters because an existing interface card occupies x=65%-96%, y=46%-75%. That central-right rectangular area should show only calm sea and a little plain road, NOT the car or a key visual detail. Keep a small car drawn from behind with two physically consistent visible wheels, windows, lights, simple confident outline; simplify tiny front and rear decorations. Keep the road perspective coherent and natural. Avoid overworked foliage: reduce the small brush marks in shrub masses, keep a few broad selected brush shapes. Gentle handmade irregularity, open warm ivory, no photorealism, no glossy or cinematic polish. Do not fill the blank left paper, do not add banners or frames. Maintain all other basic composition and natural hand-painted character.
final_edit_prompts.loading: Derive a matching LOADING BACKGROUND from this same quiet hand-painted coastal road artwork. Preserve exactly the soft muted palette, clear drawn shapes, small orange older car, confident economical gouache brushwork and natural relaxed coast. This is a hand-drawn illustration, not a photo, not a 3D render and not pixel art. Recompose for a full 16:9 loading-screen background: the upper 73% of the image is a FULL-WIDTH continuous coastal landscape, including the left side (remove the tall blank left paper column for this variant). Low headland and winding road with calm sea, a few broad simple shrub shapes, distant low coastline, simple cream-and-pale-blue sky with two loose flat clouds. A small orange car from behind at about x=74%, y=59%, occupying about y=52%-68%; it must be fully above the bottom blank area. Put almost no small details around it. The BOTTOM 27% is entirely warm ivory paper #f3efe3, EMPTY, reserved for native loading text and progress bar already supplied by the game. Blend the painted scene into that blank paper with a very slight loose dry-brush boundary near y=72%, keeping it clean and avoiding an ornamental torn edge. Nothing below y=75% except the blank ivory background. Top-left portion y=0%-25% should remain a calm simple sky behind an existing native wordmark card. No lettering, text, logos, UI, bars, cards, border, workshop, lighthouse, village, sunset, luminous clouds or extra scenery. Broad quiet shapes and lots of breathing room, gently imperfect handmade drawing, no noisy artificial brush texture or dense decorative micro-details.

scope: Only the three background asset references change; UI layout, fonts, controls, text and progress behavior remain byte-equivalent to baseline after normalizing those paths.
